note: Fixed list for talking points (SPEC-V2 §7). Each text was checked against its source page on the date above; numbers are as the source reports them. appliesTo: "na" = non-alcoholic brands only, "all" = any brand. category (optional) narrows a fact to a product category.

facts.text: Nonalcoholic beverage sales grew 30% in 2024, according to the food purchasing company Entegra.
facts.source: Opinion piece by Sidework's CEO, Restaurant Dive, Feb 5 2025 (citing Entegra)

facts.text: Venues doing about $2 million a year saw an average revenue boost of $95,000 after expanding their nonalcoholic drink menus (Entegra).
facts.source: Opinion piece by Sidework's CEO, Restaurant Dive, Feb 5 2025 (citing Entegra)

facts.text: Venues report that nonalcoholic options extend table times and increase per-party spend.
facts.source: Opinion piece by Sidework's CEO, Restaurant Dive, Feb 5 2025 (vendor anecdote)

facts.text: 39% of consumers say they are more likely to return to a restaurant or bar that offers a wide range of nonalcoholic options (data shared by Athletic Brewing).
Nonalcoholic beer already sells on-premise: Athletic Brewing alone reports a 36% share of on-premise nonalcoholic beer sales in America.
Nearly half (46%) of consumers globally say they are likely to buy a drink on a bartender's recommendation.
Bartenders name reliability and support as two of the three most important things a brand needs to thrive.
